title: 事務用シュレッダー
description: 事務室・公共窓口のバックヤード向けのシュレッダー外観。分かれた傾斜給紙面と実開口の投入口、固定給紙ローラー、独立した裁断ヘッド外装、取っ手付きの開放上面回収箱と実開口の確認窓、支持枠・キャスター・背面接続口を造形。窓ガラス、裁断歯、紙片は付属せず、箱・ローラーは固定されています。給紙・裁断・電気動作や安全・情報破棄性能の検証、認証はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.370 × 0.565 × 0.345 m、9,516三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A document-shredder exterior for office and civic-service back rooms. Features split sloping feed surfaces around a genuine inlet, fixed feed rollers, a separate cutter-head exterior, open-topped removable-bin form with pull and real sight opening, support frame, casters and rear connection. Window glazing, cutting teeth and paper scraps are not included; bin and rollers remain fixed. No feeding, shredding or electrical behavior, safety/data-destruction validation or certification. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.370 × 0.565 × 0.345 m; 9,516 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
